# KYOWA SHOP -AsaKusaBashi-

> Flagship store of Kyowa Co., Ltd. (株式会社協和, founded 1948), a Japanese bag maker.
> Located in Asakusabashi, Tokyo — about 10 minutes on foot from Akihabara.
> The shop offers colorful, "spirit-lifting" bags including the Leather Style line
> (made with Clarino synthetic leather), randoseru, backpacks, and suitcases.

## Key facts

- Store name: KYOWA SHOP -AsaKusaBashi-
- Operator: Kyowa Co., Ltd. (株式会社協和), founded 1948
- Address: WORKING FORT Higashi-Kanda, 2-10-16 Higashi-Kanda, Chiyoda-ku, Tokyo 101-0031
- Access: ~5 min walk from JR Asakusabashi Sta. and JR Bakurocho Sta.; ~10 min from JR Akihabara Sta.
- Hours: 10:00–16:00, open every day including weekends
- Payment: credit cards
- Languages: English and Japanese
- Reservation: optional; walk-ins welcome. A reservation form is on the landing page.

## Signature products (Leather Style, by HIDEO WAKAMATSU, made by Kyowa)

- Kawaii Chic Shoulder (Regular) — JPY 22,000
- Kawaii Chic Mini Backpack — JPY 33,000
- Leather-Style Backpack — JPY 66,000

Prices and lineup may change.
